**retrieval outside a git repository:** `pixel search-content` and `pixel find-code` no longer hang for minutes when an ancestor directory (such as `/tmp`) holds a `.pixel/base.shard`. The change check of a tree without `.git` now stops at the index time budget (`PIXEL_INDEX_BUDGET_MS`, 5 s) with an error that names the root and says it is not inside a git repository, and no daemon is started for a root without `.git`; the command runs in process.
